_comment: Shared corpus for #3031: every locator must pick the element carrying data-expect-root (or none). Read by python/tests/test_root_selection_3031.py and crates/djust_live (dj_root_selection_3031). The rendered-HTML locator is the Rust scanner ("scanner"); "python" is the template-SOURCE locator (_search_dj_root_open), which also balances {% if %} branches. "content" is the root's inner HTML (null: no complete close tag), checked against html5ever's tree.

cases.name: textarea_incomplete_end_token
cases.why: An end-tag name plus whitespace at EOF is not a complete token; the root exists but its content range is unavailable.

cases.name: textarea_unterminated_end_attribute

cases.name: textarea_complete_end_attribute

cases.name: lookalike_in_title

cases.name: lookalike_in_template_element
cases.why: template content is a separate fragment in html5ever; Python and the scanner read it as markup (predates #3031)

cases.name: rendered_if_else_text_is_text
cases.why: rendered output has no template branches: {% if %}/{% else %} left in it (a {% verbatim %} block, say) is text to html5ever, so the root closes at its own balancing . The template-source balancer read it as branches and found no close (the whole page became the frame)

cases.name: body_tag_inside_embedded_child_merges_onto_body
cases.why: #3302 beside #3031: a <body> start tag anywhere adds its attributes to the one body element (html5ever, browsers), so a child document's <body dj-view> inside its wrapper makes the page's body the root when nothing else declares one. The body closes at the LAST </body>

cases.name: body_attributes_merge_from_a_later_body_tag
cases.why: the root is the body element, whose open tag is the first <body>; a later <body dj-root> only adds the attribute

cases.name: body_that_is_an_embedded_wrapper_is_not_a_root
cases.why: a body carrying another view's container attributes belongs to that view (#3031), as on any other element

cases.name: stray_body_close_in_embedded_child_keeps_the_page_body_open
cases.why: html5ever never closes the body early: after a child's stray </body></html> the rest of the page is still body content, so the body root runs to the last </body>

cases.name: lt_in_tag_name
cases.why: a '<' inside a tag name is part of the name (html5ever): <div<x dj-root> is an element named div<x carrying dj-root

cases.name: lt_in_unquoted_value
cases.why: a '<' in an unquoted value is part of the value; the next attribute still counts

cases.name: quote_in_attribute_name
cases.why: a quote in an attribute name is part of the name, not the start of a value

cases.name: nul_in_tag_name
cases.why: a NUL in a tag name is part of it (html5ever reads it as U+FFFD); the close tag spelled the same balances it

cases.name: unterminated_quoted_value_drops_the_tag
cases.why: a quoted value open at EOF discards the whole tag, so its dj-root is not a root; the dj-view before it is

cases.name: tag_open_at_eof_after_the_root
cases.why: a tag left open at EOF is discarded; the root before it is unaffected

cases.name: lookalike_in_double_escaped_script
cases.why: inside <!-- in a script, a <script> start makes the next </script> text (the script data double-escaped state), so html5ever reads the lookalike as script text; the scanner and Python end the script at the first </script>. Not modelled yet
